    "FUNCTION STREE_EXIT_TO_OBJECT_DOKU.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"       IMPORTING",
    "*\"             VALUE(SELECTED_NODE) LIKE  HIER_IFACE",
    "*\"                             STRUCTURE  HIER_IFACE",
    "*\"             VALUE(EXIT_FROM_STRUCTURE_DISPLAY)",
    "*\"                             LIKE  HIER_TYPES-CHAR1 DEFAULT 'X'",
    "*\"             VALUE(ACTIVITY) LIKE  HIER_TYPES-REF_ACTION",
    "*\"                             DEFAULT '00'",
    "*\"             VALUE(ICONNAME) LIKE  HIER_REFTY-ICONNAME OPTIONAL",
    "*\"             VALUE(LANGUAGE) LIKE  SY-LANGU DEFAULT SY-LANGU",
    "*\"       EXPORTING",
    "*\"             VALUE(MESSAGE) LIKE  HIER_MESS STRUCTURE  HIER_MESS",
    "*\"       TABLES",
    "*\"              LIST_OF_REFERENCES STRUCTURE  HIER_REF",
    "*\"              STRUCTURE_TABLE STRUCTURE  HIER_IFACE OPTIONAL",
    "*\"              USER_PARAMETERS STRUCTURE  STREEPROP OPTIONAL",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* function module only as master for copying !!!",
    "* function module is used as exit from the structure editor to (a)",
    "* referenced object(S).",
    "*",
    "* the parameter EXIT_FROM_STRUCTURE_DISPLAY defines if the module",
    "* is called from the structure display or the edit mode. Default is",
    "* exit from display.",
    "*",
    "* ACTIVITY contains the requested action.",
    "* All actions described in data-element HIER_ACTIO (domain HIER_ACTIO",
    "* resp.) must be supported. A default action is given if no distinct",
    "* action was selected by the user (this is usually the case when the",
    "* exit is called from the structure display)",
    "*",
    "* table LIST_OF_REFERENCES contains a list of all references for the",
    "* selected node(s). There may be more than one object given! Also there",
    "* may be references to other objects.",
    "*",
    "* table STRUCTURE_TABLE is optional and can be used to retrive some",
    "* hierarchy information.",
    "  DATA: F_DOKCLASS LIKE DSYAS-CHILD_CLS,",
    "        F_IMP_DOKNAME(60),",
    "*        F_DOKTITLE LIKE ttreet-text,",
    "        F_DOKTITLE LIKE DSYAT-CHILD_TITL,",
    "        F_WORK_DSYAH LIKE DSYAH,",
    "        F_VIEWNAME LIKE DSYAV-VIEWNAME,",
    "        F_PF15_EXIT,",

    "    EXIT.",

    "    IF EXIT_FROM_STRUCTURE_DISPLAY EQ TRUE.",

    "      F_IMP_DOKNAME = LIST_OF_REFERENCES-REF_OBJECT+4.",
    "      f_work_dsyah-attribut_1 = 'I'.",
    "*",
    "      read table user_parameters with key name = 'SHI_DOKTITLE'.",

    "        f_doktitle = user_parameters-value.",
    "      endif.",
    "      if not selected_node-reftree_id is initial.",
    "        tree_id = selected_node-reftree_id.",

    "FUNCTION DOCU_EXIST_CHECK.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Local interface:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EXTEND_EXCEPT) DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(ID) LIKE  DOKHL-ID",
    "*\"     VALUE(LANGU) LIKE  DOKHL-LANGU DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(OBJECT) LIKE  DOKHL-OBJECT",
    "*\"     VALUE(TYP) LIKE  DOKHL-TYP DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(DOCU_INDEX) LIKE  DOKIL STRUCTURE  DOKIL",
    "*\"     VALUE(OBJECT_NOT_FOUND)",
    "*\"     VALUE(SELFDEF) LIKE  DOKIL-SELFDEF",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      NO_DOCU_ON_SCREEN",
    "*\"      NO_DOCU_SELF_DEF",
    "*\"      NO_DOCU_TEMP",
    "*\"      RET_CODE",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  TABLES : TSDOC.           \"#EC *",
    "  DATA KUNDE_OR_SAP(1).",
    "  DATA SYS_TYP(10).",
    "* IF SY-UNAME EQ 'LINKE' . BREAK-POINT. ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* input not complete",
    "  IF LANGU EQ '*'.",
    "    SELECT  * FROM DOKIL",
    "      WHERE ID         = ID",
    "        AND OBJECT     = OBJECT",
    "        AND TYP        = TYP",
    "        AND MASTERLANG = 'X'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDSELECT.",
    "    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.",
    "      MOVE DOKIL-LANGU TO LANGU.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      CLEAR LANGU.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF     TYP   NE SPACE",
    "     AND LANGU EQ SPACE.",
    "    RAISE RET_CODE.        \"#EC RAISE_OK",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* get data (to use for hypertext old version)",
    "  IF     TYP   EQ SPACE",
    "     AND LANGU NE SPACE.",
    "    MOVE SPACE TO OBJECT_NOT_FOUND.",
    "",
    "    IF SYS_TYP IS INITIAL.",
    "      PERFORM CHECK_SYSTYPE USING SYS_TYP.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF  SYS_TYP EQ 'SAP'.",
    "      KUNDE_OR_SAP = 'S'.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      KUNDE_OR_SAP = 'K'.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "",
    "    CASE KUNDE_OR_SAP.",
    "      WHEN 'S'.",
    "*     SAP documentation developer",
    "*     exist a text from SAP ?",
    "        SELECT SINGLE * FROM  DOKIL",
    "                        WHERE ID     = ID",
    "                        AND   OBJECT = OBJECT",
    "                        AND   LANGU  = LANGU",
    "                        AND   TYP    = 'E'.",
    "        IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.",
    "*     SAP technical documentation?",
    "          SELECT SINGLE * FROM  DOKIL",
    "                          WHERE ID     = ID",
    "                          AND   OBJECT = OBJECT",
    "                          AND   LANGU  = LANGU",
    "                          AND   TYP    = 'T'.",
    "          IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.",
    "*       no SAP text, is there a customer text?",
    "            SELECT SINGLE * FROM  DOKIL",
    "                            WHERE ID     = ID",
    "                            AND   OBJECT = OBJECT",
    "                            AND   LANGU  = LANGU",
    "                            AND   TYP    = 'U'.",
    "            IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.",
    "*           no text at all, set default values",
    "              MOVE : ID           TO DOCU_INDEX-ID,",
    "                     OBJECT         TO DOCU_INDEX-OBJECT,",
    "                     LANGU          TO DOCU_INDEX-LANGU,",
    "                     'E'            TO DOCU_INDEX-TYP,",
    "                     1              TO DOCU_INDEX-VERSION,",
    "                     SPACE          TO DOCU_INDEX-MASTERLANG,",
    "                     SPACE          TO DOCU_INDEX-TXTLINES,",
    "                     SPACE          TO DOCU_INDEX-DOKSTATE,",
    "                     SPACE          TO DOCU_INDEX-SELFDEF.",
    "              MOVE   'X'            TO OBJECT_NOT_FOUND.",
    "            ELSE.",
    "              MOVE DOKIL TO DOCU_INDEX.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            MOVE DOKIL TO DOCU_INDEX.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          MOVE DOKIL TO DOCU_INDEX.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      WHEN 'K'.",
    "*       customer documentation developer",
    "*       exist a customer text?",
    "        SELECT SINGLE * FROM  DOKIL",
    "                        WHERE ID     = ID",
    "                        AND   OBJECT = OBJECT",
    "                        AND   LANGU  = LANGU",
    "                        AND   TYP    = 'U'.",
    "*       not cutomer text, is there a SAP text",
    "        IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.",
    "          SELECT SINGLE * FROM  DOKIL",
    "                          WHERE ID     = ID",
    "                          AND   OBJECT = OBJECT",
    "                          AND   LANGU  = LANGU",
    "                          AND   TYP    = 'E'.",
    "          IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.",
    "*     SAP technical documentation?",
    "            SELECT SINGLE * FROM  DOKIL",
    "                            WHERE ID     = ID",
    "                            AND   OBJECT = OBJECT",
    "                            AND   LANGU  = LANGU",
    "                            AND   TYP    = 'T'.",
    "            IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.",
    "*           no text at all, set default values",
    "              MOVE : ID           TO DOCU_INDEX-ID,",
    "                     OBJECT         TO DOCU_INDEX-OBJECT,",
    "                     LANGU          TO DOCU_INDEX-LANGU,",
    "                     'U'            TO DOCU_INDEX-TYP,",
    "                     1              TO DOCU_INDEX-VERSION,",
    "                     SPACE          TO DOCU_INDEX-MASTERLANG,",
    "                     SPACE          TO DOCU_INDEX-TXTLINES,",
    "                     SPACE          TO DOCU_INDEX-DOKSTATE,",
    "                     SPACE          TO DOCU_INDEX-SELFDEF.",
    "              MOVE   'X'            TO OBJECT_NOT_FOUND.",
    "            ELSE.",
    "              MOVE DOKIL TO DOCU_INDEX.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            MOVE DOKIL TO DOCU_INDEX.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          MOVE DOKIL TO DOCU_INDEX.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "    EXIT.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* get information of selfdef or not (to use in dictionary)",
    "  IF     TYP   EQ SPACE",
    "     AND LANGU EQ SPACE.",
    "    CLEAR SELFDEF.",
    "    SELECT * FROM DOKIL",
    "             WHERE ID     = ID",
    "             AND   OBJECT = OBJECT.",
    "    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.",
    "      MOVE DOKIL-SELFDEF TO SELFDEF.",
    "      MOVE DOKIL TO DOCU_INDEX.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDSELECT.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* read header information of object (to use in documentation old vers.)",
    "  IF     TYP   NE SPACE",
    "     AND LANGU NE SPACE.",
    "    CLEAR DOKIL.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE * FROM  DOKIL",
    "                    WHERE ID         = ID",
    "                    AND   OBJECT     = OBJECT",
    "                    AND   LANGU      = LANGU",
    "                    AND   TYP        = TYP.",
    "    IF SY-SUBRC GT 0.",
    "      RAISE RET_CODE.                        \"#EC RAISE_OK",
    "    ELSE.",
    "* die ausnahmebehandlung ist falsch, da ein objekt nicht zu",
    "* dokumentieren ist, wenn es in irgendeiner sprache nicht zu",
    "* dokumentieren ist.",
    "      IF DOKIL-DOKSTATE EQ 'N'.",
    "        IF EXTEND_EXCEPT EQ SPACE.",
    "          RAISE RET_CODE.                     \"#EC RAISE_OK",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          CASE DOKIL-SELFDEF.",
    "            WHEN '1'.",
    "              RAISE NO_DOCU_ON_SCREEN.        \"#EC RAISE_OK",
    "            WHEN '2'.",
    "              RAISE NO_DOCU_TEMP.             \"#EC RAISE_OK",
    "            WHEN '3'.",
    "              RAISE NO_DOCU_SELF_DEF.         \"#EC RAISE_OK",
    "            WHEN OTHERS.",
    "              RAISE RET_CODE.                 \"#EC RAISE_OK",
    "          ENDCASE.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "ENDFUNCTION.",
    "*---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*       FORM CHECK_SYSTYPE                                            *",
    "*---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*       ........                                                      *",
    "*---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*  -->  SYS_TYP                                                       *",
    "*---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "FORM CHECK_SYSTYPE USING SYS_TYP.",
    "  IF SYS_TYP IS INITIAL.",
    "    PERFORM GETSYSTYPE(RDDINSYS) USING SYS_TYP.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "ENDFORM."
  ],

  "sourceFingerprint": "4f40f268bcfd4b20ca7bed9772c240ae316656741d2e29c0a1a15b5aa22e60f1"
}

    "            STRUCTURE_ID               = STRUCTURE_ID",
    "            DO_NOT_READ_DEVCLASS       = 'X'",
    "       IMPORTING",
    "*         MESSAGE                    =",
    "            STRUCTURE_HEADER           = STRUCTURE_HEADER.",
    "*         STRUCTURE_IS_ORIGINAL      =",
    "*         STRUCTURE_IS_TRANSPORTABLE =.",
    "*",
    "**  node_table_name = table_name.",
    "* fill interface",
    "  I_LIST_OF_NODES-NODE_ID = NODE_ID.",
    "  APPEND I_LIST_OF_NODES.",
    "  I_LIST_OF_NODES2-NODE_ID = NODE_ID.",
    "  APPEND I_LIST_OF_NODES2.",
    "",
    "  IF table_name NE space. \"Sharmarajk",
    "* get node infos",
    "  SELECT SINGLE * FROM (TABLE_NAME)",
    "                               INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF NODE_INFO",
    "                             WHERE NODE_ID   = NODE_ID",
    "                               AND EXT_KEY   = STRUCTURE_HEADER-EXT_KEY.",
    "*                               AND EXTENSION = EXTENSION.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    EXIT.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  IF node_info-reftree_id NE space AND",
    "     NODE_INFO-W_SUBNODES NE SPACE AND",
    "     NODE_INFO-REFNODE_ID EQ SPACE.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'STREE_STRUCTURE_EXIST'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        STRUCTURE_ID                     = NODE_INFO-REFTREE_ID",
    "*        READ_FROM_DATABASE               =",
    "*        DO_NOT_READ_DEVCLASS             = ' '",
    "     IMPORTING",
    "*        MESSAGE                          =",
    "       STRUCTURE_HEADER                 = REFNODE_HEADER",
    "*        STRUCTURE_IS_ORIGINAL            =",
    "*        STRUCTURE_IS_TRANSPORTABLE       =",
    "*        STRUCTURE_TADIR                  =",
    "              .",
    "",
    "    NODE_INFO-REFNODE_ID = REFNODE_HEADER-NODE_ID.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "* get references",
    "* if node refers to another node, get also references of that node",
    "  IF NOT NODE_INFO-REFNODE_ID IS INITIAL.",
    "    I_LIST_OF_NODES-NODE_ID = NODE_INFO-REFNODE_ID.",
    "    APPEND I_LIST_OF_NODES.",
    "    I_LIST_OF_NODES2-NODE_ID = NODE_INFO-REFNODE_ID.",
    "    APPEND I_LIST_OF_NODES2.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF READ_REFERENCES = TRUE OR READ_TEXT EQ TRUE.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'STREE_READ_REFERENCES_GENER'",
    "         EXPORTING",
    "              STRUCTURE_ID      = STRUCTURE_ID",
    "              TABLE_NAME        = TABLE_NAME",
    "              BYPASS_BUFFER     = 'X'",
    "*    IMPORTING",
    "*         MESSAGE            =",
    "         TABLES",
    "              LIST_OF_NODES      = I_LIST_OF_NODES",
    "              LIST_OF_REFERENCES = NODE_REFERENCES",
    "         EXCEPTIONS",
    "              OTHERS             = 1.",
    "    if NODE_INFO-REFtreE_ID ne space and NODE_INFO-REFNODE_ID ne space.",
    "     read table node_references with key node_id = NODE_INFO-REFNODE_ID.",
    "      if sy-subrc ne 0.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'STREE_NODE_READ'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            STRUCTURE_ID              = NODE_INFO-REFtreE_ID",
    "*       DATABASE_IDENTIFIER       =",
    "            NODE_ID                   = NODE_INFO-REFNODE_ID",
    "*     IMPORTING",
    "*       NODE_INFO                 =",
    "*       NODE_TEXT                 =",
    "*       MESSAGE                   =",
    "          TABLES",
    "            NODE_REFERENCES           = refNODE_REFERENCES.",
    "        append lines of refNODE_REFERENCES to NODE_REFERENCES.",
    "      endif.",
    "    endif.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "* get text",
    "  IF READ_TEXT EQ TRUE.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'STREE_READ_TEXTS_GENER'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "             STRUCTURE_ID   = STRUCTURE_ID",
    "              TABLE_NAME    = TABLE_NAME",
    "              BYPASS_BUFFER = 'X'",
    "              READ_TEXTS_WITHOUT_NODES = ' '",
    "*          LANGUAGE      = SY-LANGU",
    "*     IMPORTING",
    "*          MESSAGE       =",
    "         TABLES",
    "              LIST_OF_NODES = I_LIST_OF_NODES               \"2",
    "              LIST_OF_TEXTS = I_LIST_OF_TEXTS",
    "         EXCEPTIONS",
    "              OTHERS        = 1.",
    "* fill interface",
    "    read table i_list_of_texts into node_text with key spras = sy-langu.",
    "    if sy-subrc ne 0.",
    "      read table i_list_of_texts into node_text with key spras = 'E'.",
    "      if sy-subrc ne 0.",
    "        READ TABLE I_LIST_OF_TEXTS INTO NODE_TEXT INDEX 1.",
    "      endif.",
    "    endif.",
    "    IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.  \"maybe text is not stored in our tables",
    "* check if any of the selected nodes is of a type whose shorttext is",
    "* taken from a reference object.",
    "      IF READ_NODE_TYPES_OWN_SHORTTEXT EQ FALSE.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'STREE_NODE_TYPE_GET_WITH_PROP'",
    "             EXPORTING",
    "                  PROPERTY                 = PROPERTY_OWN_SHORTTEXT",
    "*     IMPORTING",
    "*          MESSAGE                  =",
    "             TABLES",
    "               NODE_TYPES_WITH_PROPERTY = NODE_TYPES_WITH_OWN_SHORTTEXT",
    "               NODE_TYPES_DEFINITION    = NODE_TYPES_WITH_OWN_STEXT_DEF",
    "             EXCEPTIONS",
    "                  OTHERS                   = 0.",
    "        READ_NODE_TYPES_OWN_SHORTTEXT = TRUE.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "*",
    "      READ TABLE NODE_TYPES_WITH_OWN_STEXT_DEF",
    "                 WITH KEY NODE_TYPE = NODE_INFO-NODE_TYPE.",
    "      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.",
    "        NODE_TEXT-NODE_ID   = NODE_ID.",
    "        NODE_TEXT-EXTENSION = EXTENSION.",
    "        PERFORM GET_SHORTTEXT",
    "                TABLES   NODE_REFERENCES",
    "                USING    NODE_TYPES_WITH_OWN_STEXT_DEF-STXT_RTYPE",
    "                CHANGING NODE_TEXT.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      READ TABLE I_LIST_OF_TEXTS INTO NODE_TEXT",
    "           WITH KEY spras   = sy-langu",
    "                    NODE_ID = NODE_ID.",
    "      if sy-subrc ne 0.",
    "        READ TABLE I_LIST_OF_TEXTS INTO NODE_TEXT",
    "             WITH KEY spras   = 'E'",
    "                      NODE_ID = NODE_ID.",
    "      endif.",
    "      IF SY-SUBRC NE 0 OR NODE_TEXT IS INITIAL.",
    "        IF NOT NODE_INFO-REFNODE_ID IS INITIAL.",
    "          READ TABLE I_LIST_OF_TEXTS INTO NODE_TEXT",
    "               WITH KEY spras   = sy-langu",
    "                        NODE_ID = NODE_INFO-REFNODE_ID.",
    "          IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.",
    "            READ TABLE I_LIST_OF_TEXTS INTO NODE_TEXT",
    "             WITH KEY spras   = 'E'",
    "                      NODE_ID = NODE_INFO-REFNODE_ID.",
    "            if sy-subrc ne 0.",
    "              READ TABLE I_LIST_OF_TEXTS INTO NODE_TEXT INDEX 1.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          endif.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          READ TABLE I_LIST_OF_TEXTS INTO NODE_TEXT INDEX 1.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "* set marker to identify references from a refered node",
    "  NODE_REFERENCES-FROM_RNODE = TRUE.",
    "  NODE_REFERENCES-NODE_ID    = NODE_ID.",
    "  MODIFY NODE_REFERENCES TRANSPORTING NODE_ID FROM_RNODE WHERE",
    "                          NODE_ID = NODE_INFO-REFNODE_ID.",
    "  CLEAR NODE_REFERENCES.",
    "*",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],
  "fingerprint": "7a1e6506128899fbe16d2ca49117fd3febce0cea0f03190349970b0a69155f9b",

}

    "FUNCTION stree_get_path_to_node.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(STRUCTURE_ID) TYPE  HIER_TREEG",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(SEARCH_FOR_NODE) TYPE  HIER_IFACE",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(IGNORE_STRUCTURE_ID) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(CHECK_SELECTED_TREE_TYPES) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      USER_PARAMETERS STRUCTURE  STREEPROP OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      CHILD_STRUCTURES STRUCTURE  HIER_CTREE OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      NODE_HIERARCHY STRUCTURE  HIER_IFACE",
    "*\"      I_TREETYPES STRUCTURE  TTREETYPE",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*",
    "  DATA: check_nodes  LIKE hier_iface OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.",
    "  DATA: parent_nodes LIKE hier_iface OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.",
    "  DATA: tree_nodes   LIKE hier_iface OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.",
    "  DATA: top_tree_node LIKE hier_iface.",
    "  DATA: tree_entry_node LIKE hier_iface.",
    "  DATA: nodes_in_structures LIKE hier_iface OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.",
    "  DATA: search_tree LIKE ttree-id.",
    "",
    "* correction to check for Active Nodes",
    "  DATA: lv_is_active,",
    "        lv_active_node_found,",
    "        lv_index TYPE i,",
    "        lv_structure_id LIKE child_structures-id,",
    "        lv_child_node LIKE child_structures-child_node,",
    "        lv_child_structure_id LIKE child_structures-id,",
    "        lv_extension LIKE hier_iface-extension.",
    "",
    "",
    "  IF ignore_structure_id EQ space.",
    "* if a new structure is given, read child structures from DB",
    "    IF child_structures_structure_id NE structure_id.",
    "      CLEAR child_structures_memory. REFRESH child_structures_memory.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "* get first the child structures of the selected structure",
    "    DESCRIBE TABLE child_structures_memory LINES table_lines.",
    "    IF table_lines EQ 0.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'STREE_GET_CHILD_STRUCTURES'",
    "           EXPORTING",
    "                structure_id     = structure_id",
    "*    IMPORTING",
    "*         MESSAGE          =",
    "           TABLES",
    "                user_parameters  = user_parameters",
    "                child_structures = child_structures_memory.",
    "      child_structures[] = child_structures_memory[].",
    "      child_structures_structure_id = structure_id.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      child_structures[] = child_structures_memory[].",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    SORT child_structures BY child_id.",
    "* read first data of the given node",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'STREE_NODE_READ'",
    "         EXPORTING",
    "              structure_id        = search_for_node-tree_id",
    "*         DATABASE_IDENTIFIER =",
    "              node_id             = search_for_node-node_id",
    "        IMPORTING",
    "             node_info           = check_nodes.",
    "*         NODE_TEXT           =",
    "*         MESSAGE             =",
    "*    TABLES",
    "*         NODE_REFERENCES     =",
    "    .",
    "    APPEND check_nodes.",
    "    APPEND check_nodes TO node_hierarchy.",
    "    IF check_nodes-tree_id NE space AND",
    "       check_nodes-tree_id NE search_for_node-tree_id.",
    "      search_tree = check_nodes-tree_id.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      search_tree = search_for_node-tree_id.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "* now get parents of the given node",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'STREE_GET_PARENTS_OF_NODE'",
    "         EXPORTING",
    "              structure_id = search_tree \"SEARCH_FOR_NODE-TREE_ID",
    "*    IMPORTING",
    "*         MESSAGE      =",
    "         TABLES",
    "              check_nodes  = check_nodes",
    "              parent_nodes = parent_nodes.",
    "*      append lines of parent_nodes to NODE_HIERARCHY.",
    "    LOOP AT parent_nodes INTO node_hierarchy.",

    "*\"              SUBOBJECT_HAS_NO_TABLES",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  data: rc like sy-subrc.",
    "",
    "  perform refresh_i_tab.",

    "",
    "  if sy-subrc eq 0.",

    "",
    "    describe table i_objs.",
    "    if sy-tfill ne 0.",

    "",
    "* Rekursion ausschließen",

    "",

    "FUNCTION STREE_GET_NODE_USAGE.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"       IMPORTING",
    "*\"             VALUE(CHECK_SELECTED_TREE_TYPES) TYPE  CHAR1",
    "*\"                             DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"             VALUE(NODE_ID) LIKE  HIER_IFACE-NODE_ID",
    "*\"       EXPORTING",
    "*\"             VALUE(MESSAGE) LIKE  HIER_MESS STRUCTURE  HIER_MESS",
    "*\"       TABLES",
    "*\"              I_TREETYPES STRUCTURE  TTREETYPE OPTIONAL",
    "*\"              USED_IN_STRUCTURES STRUCTURE  TTREE OPTIONAL",
    "*\"              NODES_IN_STRUCTURES STRUCTURE  HIER_IFACE OPTIONAL",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*",
    "  DATA: FUNCTION_MODULE LIKE TFDIR-FUNCNAME.",
    "  DATA: TABLE_NAME LIKE TTREETYPE-DB_TABLE.",
    "  DATA: I_TTREETYPE LIKE TTREETYPE OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.",
    "  DATA: REF_STRUCTURES LIKE TTREE OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.",
    "  DATA: REF_NODES LIKE HIER_IFACE OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.",
    "  DATA: TABLE_LINES LIKE SY-TABIX.",
    "*",
    "  CLEAR MESSAGE.",
    "*",
    "  DESCRIBE TABLE I_TREETYPES LINES TABLE_LINES.",
    "  IF CHECK_SELECTED_TREE_TYPES EQ TRUE AND TABLE_LINES GT 0.",
    "    SELECT * FROM TTREETYPE INTO TABLE I_TTREETYPE",
    "             FOR ALL ENTRIES IN I_TREETYPES",
    "             WHERE TREE_TYPE = I_TREETYPES-TREE_TYPE",
    "               AND ACTIVE = TRUE.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    SELECT * FROM TTREETYPE INTO TABLE I_TTREETYPE WHERE ACTIVE = TRUE.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*",
    "*",
    "  SORT I_TTREETYPE BY DB_IDENT DB_TABLE.",
    "  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM I_TTREETYPE",
    "                             COMPARING DB_IDENT DB_TABLE.",
    "*",
    "  LOOP AT I_TTREETYPE.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'STREE_GET_FUNCTION_MODULE'",
    "         EXPORTING",
    "              STRUCTURE_ID        = ' '",
    "              DATABASE_IDENTIFIER = I_TTREETYPE-DB_IDENT",
    "              DATABASE_TABLENAME  = I_TTREETYPE-DB_TABLE",
    "              ACTION              = 'NU'",
    "         IMPORTING",
    "              FUNCTION_MODULE     = FUNCTION_MODULE",
    "*         DATABASE_IDENTIFIER =",
    "              DATABASE_TABLENAME  = TABLE_NAME",
    "              MESSAGE             = MESSAGE",
    "         EXCEPTIONS",
    "              OTHERS              = 0.",
    "* STREE_READ_NODE_REF_XXXXX",
    "    CLEAR REF_STRUCTURES. REFRESH REF_STRUCTURES.",
    "    CLEAR REF_NODES. REFRESH REF_NODES.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION FUNCTION_MODULE",
    "         EXPORTING",
    "              node_ID                = NODE_ID",
    "              TABLE_NAME             = TABLE_NAME",
    "         TABLES",
    "              REFERENCING_STRUCTURES = REF_STRUCTURES",
    "              REFERENCING_NODES      = REF_NODES",
    "         EXCEPTIONS",
    "              OTHERS                 = 1.",
    "    APPEND LINES OF REF_STRUCTURES TO USED_IN_STRUCTURES.",
    "    APPEND LINES OF REF_NODES TO NODES_IN_STRUCTURES.",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "*",
    "ENDFUNCTION."

    "FUNCTION stree_get_function_module.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",

    "*\"  IMPORTING",

    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        OTHERS               = 0.",
    "",
    "    IF message-msgid NE space.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*",
    "  CASE action.",
    "    WHEN '1'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_read_top_line.",
    "    WHEN 'AN'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_read_all_nodes.",
    "    WHEN 'AJ'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_read_top_line.",
    "    when 'AD'.                                       \"RK 07012002",
    "      function_module = global_adjacent_objects.     \"RK 07012002",
    "    WHEN 'BU'.",
    "      function_module = global_update_buffer.",

    "      ttreetype-db_ident  = existing_tree_types-db_ident.",
    "      ttreetype-db_table  = existing_tree_types-db_table.",

    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM ttreetype",

    "FUNCTION docu_read.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(ID) LIKE  DOKHL-ID",
    "*\"     VALUE(LANGU) LIKE  DOKHL-LANGU",
    "*\"     VALUE(OBJECT) LIKE  DOKHL-OBJECT",
    "*\"     VALUE(TYP) LIKE  DOKHL-TYP",
    "*\"     VALUE(VERSION) LIKE  DOKHL-DOKVERSION",
    "*\"     VALUE(SUPPRESS_TEMPLATE) LIKE  SY-BATCH DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(USE_NOTE_TEMPLATE) TYPE  CHAR1 DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(DOKTITLE) LIKE  DSYST-DOKTITLE",
    "*\"     VALUE(HEAD) LIKE  THEAD STRUCTURE  THEAD",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      LINE",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  DATA : save_object LIKE dokhl-object.\" only used in docu_read",
    "  DATA : l_version LIKE dokhl-dokversion.               \"LOLL",
    "",
    "  CLEAR dokhl.",
    "  CLEAR doktl.",
    "* CLEAR DSYST.\"4.7.95",
    "",
    "  CLEAR:   iline, line, idoktl.",
    "  REFRESH: iline, line, idoktl.",
    "",
    "  SELECT SINGLE * FROM dokhl",
    "    WHERE id         = id",
    "    AND   object     = object",
    "    AND   langu      = langu",
    "    AND   typ        = typ",
    "    AND   dokversion = version.",
    "",
    "  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "    head-tdname     = dokhl-object.",
    "    head-tdid       = dokhl-id.",
    "    head-tdspras    = dokhl-langu.",
    "    head-tdform     = dokhl-dokform.",
    "    head-tdstyle    = dokhl-dokstyle.",
    "    head-tdversion  = dokhl-dokversion.",
    "    head-tdfuser    = dokhl-dokfuser.",
    "    head-tdfreles   = dokhl-dokfreles.",
    "    head-tdfdate    = dokhl-dokfdate.",
    "    head-tdftime    = dokhl-dokftime.",
    "    head-tdluser    = dokhl-dokluser.",
    "    head-tdlreles   = dokhl-doklreles.",
    "    head-tdldate    = dokhl-dokldate.",
    "    head-tdltime    = dokhl-dokltime.",
    "    head-tdlinesize = '072'.",
    "",
    "    CASE id.",
    "      WHEN 'HY'.",
    "        head-tdobject = 'DSYS'.",
    "*     WHEN 'IN'.",
    "*       HEAD-TDOBJECT = 'INFO'.",
    "      WHEN OTHERS.",
    "        head-tdobject = 'DOKU'.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "",
    "    IF object(c_report_length) NE 'TEMPLATE'.",
    "      IF dokhl-dokstate    EQ C_A AND",
    "         sdoc-profile+1(1) EQ 'M'.",
    "        head-tdversion = head-tdversion + 1.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "",
    "    SELECT * FROM doktl INTO TABLE idoktl",
    "      WHERE id         =  id",
    "      AND   object     =  object",
    "      AND   langu      =  langu",
    "      AND   typ        =  typ",
    "      AND   dokversion =  version",
    "      ORDER BY PRIMARY KEY.",
    "",
    "    CLEAR idoktl.",
    "    READ TABLE idoktl INDEX 1.",
    "",
    "    IF idoktl-doktext(5) NE '{\\rtf'.",
    "      LOOP AT idoktl.",
    "        PERFORM line_append.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      LOOP AT idoktl.",
    "        MOVE idoktl-dokformat TO iline-tdformat.",
    "        MOVE idoktl-doktext TO iline-tdline.",
    "        APPEND iline.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",

  "source": [
    "FUNCTION STREE_READ_REFERENCES_GENER.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(STRUCTURE_ID) LIKE  TTREE-ID",
    "*\"     VALUE(TABLE_NAME) LIKE  TTREETYPE-DB_TABLE",
    "*\"     VALUE(BYPASS_BUFFER) LIKE  HIER_TYPES-CHAR1 DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(MESSAGE) LIKE  HIER_MESS STRUCTURE  HIER_MESS",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      LIST_OF_NODES STRUCTURE  HIER_IFACE",
    "*\"      LIST_OF_REFERENCES STRUCTURE  HIER_REF",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  DATA: STRUCTURE_HEADER LIKE TTREE.",
    "  DATA: NODES LIKE TNODE01 OCCURS 1 WITH HEADER LINE.",
    "  DATA: REFNODES LIKE TNODE01 OCCURS 1 WITH HEADER LINE.",
    "  DATA: REFTREE_ID LIKE TTREE OCCURS 1 WITH HEADER LINE.",
    "  DATA: E_STRUCTURE_HEADER LIKE TTREE OCCURS 1 WITH HEADER LINE.",
    "  DATA: REFNODETABNAME(16).",
    "*  data: ref_list like tnode01r occurs 0 with header line.",
    "  DATA: START_INDEX LIKE SY-TABIX.",
    "  DATA: REF_LIST LIKE SORTED TABLE OF TNODE01R",
    "                       WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY NODE_ID",
    "                       INITIAL SIZE 0 WITH HEADER LINE.",
    "*",
    "  IF GOT_TREE_TYPE_DATA = FALSE.",
    "    SELECT * FROM TTREETYPE INTO TABLE TREE_TYPES.",
    "    SORT TREE_TYPES BY TREE_TYPE.",
    "    GOT_TREE_TYPE_DATA = TRUE.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*",
    "  CLEAR MESSAGE.",
    "*",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'STREE_STRUCTURE_EXIST'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            STRUCTURE_ID               = STRUCTURE_ID",
    "            DO_NOT_READ_DEVCLASS       = 'X'",
    "       IMPORTING",
    "*         MESSAGE                    =",
    "            STRUCTURE_HEADER           = STRUCTURE_HEADER.",
    "*         STRUCTURE_IS_ORIGINAL      =",
    "*         STRUCTURE_IS_TRANSPORTABLE =.",
    "*",
    "  CONCATENATE TABLE_NAME 'R' INTO REF_TABLE_NAME.",
    "*",
    "  REFRESH LIST_OF_REFERENCES.",
    "* check if buffered data are read. These data are already read in the",
    "* function module which reads the nodes. So we don't need to read them",
    "* here.",
    "  READ TABLE BUFFER_DATA WITH KEY TREE_ID = STRUCTURE_ID.",
    "  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0",
    "     AND BUFFER_DATA-REFS_READ EQ TRUE",
    "     AND BYPASS_BUFFER EQ FALSE.",
    "    LOOP AT LIST_OF_NODES.",
    "      LIST_OF_REFERENCES-FROM_RNODE = FALSE.",
    "      READ TABLE ALL_REFERENCES",
    "                 WITH KEY NODE_ID = LIST_OF_NODES-NODE_ID BINARY SEARCH.",
    "      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.",
    "        START_INDEX = SY-TABIX.",
    "        LOOP AT ALL_REFERENCES FROM START_INDEX.",
    "          IF ALL_REFERENCES-NODE_ID NE LIST_OF_NODES-NODE_ID.",
    "            EXIT.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          MOVE-CORRESPONDING ALL_REFERENCES TO LIST_OF_REFERENCES.",
    "          APPEND LIST_OF_REFERENCES.",
    "        ENDLOOP.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      CHECK LIST_OF_NODES-REFNODE_ID NE SPACE.",
    "      READ TABLE ALL_REFERENCES",
    "             WITH KEY NODE_ID = LIST_OF_NODES-REFNODE_ID BINARY SEARCH.",
    "      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.",
    "        START_INDEX = SY-TABIX.",
    "        LOOP AT ALL_REFERENCES FROM START_INDEX.",
    "          IF ALL_REFERENCES-NODE_ID NE LIST_OF_NODES-REFNODE_ID.",
    "            EXIT.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          MOVE-CORRESPONDING ALL_REFERENCES TO LIST_OF_REFERENCES.",
    "          LIST_OF_REFERENCES-FROM_RNODE = TRUE.",
    "          LIST_OF_REFERENCES-NODE_ID    = LIST_OF_NODES-NODE_ID.",
    "          APPEND LIST_OF_REFERENCES.",
    "        ENDLOOP.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "*",
    "    if table_name eq space.",
    "      exit.",
    "    endif.",
    "    READ TABLE LIST_OF_NODES INDEX 1 TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.",
    "    IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    LOOP AT LIST_OF_NODES.",
    "      NODES-NODE_ID    = LIST_OF_NODES-NODE_ID.",
    "      APPEND NODES.",
    "      CHECK LIST_OF_NODES-REFNODE_ID NE SPACE.",
    "      REFNODES-NODE_ID    = LIST_OF_NODES-NODE_ID.",
    "      REFNODES-REFNODE_ID = LIST_OF_NODES-REFNODE_ID.",
    "      REFNODES-REFTREE_ID = LIST_OF_NODES-REFTREE_ID.",
    "      APPEND REFNODES.",
    "      REFTREE_ID-ID = LIST_OF_NODES-REFTREE_ID.",
    "      APPEND REFTREE_ID.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "*",
    "* a node which refers to another node gets its references from that node",
    "    READ TABLE REFNODES INDEX 1.",
    "    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.",
    "      SORT REFNODES BY REFTREE_ID.",
    "      SORT REFTREE_ID BY ID.",
    "      DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM REFTREE_ID COMPARING ID.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'STREE_STRUCTURE_READ_MULTIPLE'",
    "*    IMPORTING",
    "*         MESSAGE            =",
    "           TABLES",
    "                I_STRUCTURE_IDS    = REFTREE_ID",
    "                E_STRUCTURE_HEADER = E_STRUCTURE_HEADER.",
    "      SORT E_STRUCTURE_HEADER BY TYPE.",
    "      DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM E_STRUCTURE_HEADER",
    "             COMPARING TYPE.",
    "      LOOP AT E_STRUCTURE_HEADER.",
    "        READ TABLE TREE_TYPES",
    "                WITH KEY TREE_TYPE = E_STRUCTURE_HEADER-TYPE.",
    "        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.",
    "          CONCATENATE TREE_TYPES-DB_TABLE 'R' INTO REFNODETABNAME.",
    "          SELECT * FROM (REFNODETABNAME) APPENDING TABLE REF_LIST",
    "                                 FOR ALL ENTRIES IN REFNODES",
    "                                 WHERE NODE_ID EQ REFNODES-REFNODE_ID",
    "                                AND EXT_KEY EQ STRUCTURE_HEADER-EXT_KEY.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "      LOOP AT REFNODES.",
    "        READ TABLE REF_LIST WITH KEY NODE_ID = REFNODES-REFNODE_ID",
    "                   BINARY SEARCH.",
    "        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.",
    "          START_INDEX = SY-TABIX.",
    "          LOOP AT REF_LIST FROM START_INDEX.",
    "            IF REF_LIST-NODE_ID NE REFNODES-REFNODE_ID.",
    "              EXIT.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "            MOVE-CORRESPONDING REF_LIST TO LIST_OF_REFERENCES.",
    "            LIST_OF_REFERENCES-FROM_RNODE = TRUE.",
    "            LIST_OF_REFERENCES-NODE_ID    = REFNODES-NODE_ID.",
    "            APPEND LIST_OF_REFERENCES.",
    "          ENDLOOP.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    LIST_OF_REFERENCES-FROM_RNODE = FALSE.",
    "    SELECT * FROM (REF_TABLE_NAME) INTO TABLE REF_LIST",
    "           FOR ALL ENTRIES IN NODES",
    "           WHERE NODE_ID EQ NODES-NODE_ID",
    "             AND EXT_KEY EQ STRUCTURE_HEADER-EXT_KEY.",
    "    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.",
    "      LOOP AT REF_LIST.",
    "        MOVE-CORRESPONDING REF_LIST TO LIST_OF_REFERENCES.",
    "        APPEND LIST_OF_REFERENCES.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "* delete references which shouldn't be read",
    "  if no_read_refs_checked = false.",
    "    select * from trtypeh into table no_read_refs where no_read = true.",
    "    no_read_refs_checked = true.",
    "  endif.",
    "  loop at no_read_refs.",
    "    delete list_of_references",
    "           where ref_type = no_read_refs-ref_type.",
    "  endloop.",
    "*",
    "ENDFUNCTION."

    "FUNCTION stree_get_function_module.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(STRUCTURE_ID) LIKE  HIER_IFACE-TREE_ID",
    "*\"     VALUE(DATABASE_IDENTIFIER) LIKE  TTREETYPE-DB_IDENT OPTIONAL",
    "*\"     VALUE(DATABASE_TABLENAME) LIKE  TTREETYPE-DB_TABLE OPTIONAL",
    "*\"     VALUE(ACTION) LIKE  HIER_TYPES-CHAR2",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(FUNCTION_MODULE) LIKE  TFDIR-FUNCNAME",
    "*\"     VALUE(DATABASE_IDENTIFIER) LIKE  TTREETYPE-DB_IDENT",
    "*\"     VALUE(DATABASE_TABLENAME) LIKE  TTREETYPE-DB_TABLE",
    "*\"     VALUE(NODE_TRANSPORT_OBJECT) LIKE  TTREETYPE-TRANS_OBJ",
    "*\"     VALUE(MESSAGE) LIKE  HIER_MESS STRUCTURE  HIER_MESS",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*",
    "  DATA: structure_header LIKE ttree.",
    "  CLEAR message.",
    "*",
    "* read data for selected structure. Raise message if structure",
    "* does not exist.",
    "  IF NOT structure_id IS INITIAL.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'STREE_STRUCTURE_EXIST'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        structure_id         = structure_id",
    "        do_not_read_devclass = 'X'",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "        message              = message",
    "        structure_header     = structure_header",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        OTHERS               = 0.",
    "",
    "    IF message-msgid NE space.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*",
    "  CASE action.",
    "    WHEN '1'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_read_top_line.",
    "    WHEN 'AN'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_read_all_nodes.",
    "    WHEN 'AJ'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_read_top_line.",
    "    when 'AD'.                                       \"RK 07012002",
    "      function_module = global_adjacent_objects.     \"RK 07012002",
    "    WHEN 'BU'.",
    "      function_module = global_update_buffer.",
    "    WHEN 'CC'.",
    "      function_module = global_check_for_children.",
    "    WHEN 'CH'.",
    "      function_module = global_check_structure.",
    "    WHEN 'CN'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_change_node.",
    "    WHEN 'D'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_delete.",
    "    WHEN 'DA'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_delete_all_nodes.",
    "    WHEN 'DN'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_delete_nodes.",
    "    WHEN 'DT'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_delete_texts.",
    "    WHEN 'I'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_insert_node.",
    "    WHEN 'IT'.",
    "      function_module = global_reset_internal_tables.",
    "    WHEN 'M'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_read_multi_layer.",
    "    WHEN 'NE'.",
    "      function_module = global_node_exist.",
    "    WHEN 'NR'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_check_refered_node.",
    "    WHEN 'NU'.",
    "      function_module = global_node_get_usage.",
    "    WHEN 'NW'.",
    "      function_module = global_node_type_where_used.",
    "    WHEN 'PN'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_read_parent_nodes.",
    "    WHEN 'R'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_read_references.",
    "    WHEN 'RN'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_read_node.",
    "    WHEN 'S'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_read_single_layer.",
    "    WHEN 'SC'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_save_changed_nodes.",
    "    WHEN 'SN'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_save_all_nodes.",
    "    WHEN 'SR'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_save_references.",
    "    WHEN 'DR'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_delete_references.",
    "    WHEN 'ST'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_save_texts.",
    "    WHEN 'T'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_read_texts.",
    "    WHEN 'TN'.",
    "      function_module = global_node_transport_check.",
    "    WHEN 'TR'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_read_structure_ref.",
    "    WHEN 'WR'.",
    "      function_module = global_tree_read_node_with_ref.",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "* data retrieval is basically linked to the structure type. But",
    "* a structure type may refer to the same function module like",
    "* another structure type. Therefore the entry of the field DB_IDENT",
    "* is used.",
    "* Each DB_IDENT may point to different tables.",
    "* for DB_IDENT = \"GENER\" tables must be identical to tables TNODE01x",
    "  IF NOT structure_id IS INITIAL.",
    "    READ TABLE existing_tree_types",
    "               WITH KEY tree_type = structure_header-type.",
    "    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "      ttreetype-db_ident  = existing_tree_types-db_ident.",
    "      ttreetype-db_table  = existing_tree_types-db_table.",
    "      ttreetype-trans_obj = existing_tree_types-trans_obj.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM ttreetype",
    "                          WHERE tree_type EQ structure_header-type.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "*       Display error message if no entry in TTREETYPE is found.",
    "        message-msgid = shi1_message_id.",
    "        message-msgty = message_abbort.",
    "        message-msgno = '300'.",
    "        message-msgv1 = structure_header-type.",
    "*        CALL FUNCTION 'STREE_RAISE_MESSAGE'",
    "*          EXPORTING",
    "*            message = message",
